regions.name: World map: 807 cells, 24 per row
regions.description: 807 variable-length records in 34 rows of 24 - the world map. A record is (first byte AND $0F) + 1 bytes, stated by $8103: LDA ($16),Y / AND #$0F / SEC / ADC $16, the SEC supplying the plus one. $80F5 seeks through it counting columns to CMP #$18 and rows in $14. $8853 draws it: each qualifying cell becomes one hardware sprite at column * 4 + $10 across and row * 4 + $3B down, tile $01, attribute $03 - four pixels a cell, 96 across, as background tiles each covering two by two cells (a quadrant bitmask built by $891F in $0150). Only rows 0-23 are drawn. Hardware sprites mark area entrances only. BYTE 0's low nibble is the length minus one; $80 exactly is an empty cell. BYTE 1's low three bits name the KEY that reveals the cell - $8860 subtracts one, calls $C078 for a bit mask and ANDs with $04B0, the key inventory bank 7 $F547 fills. BYTE 2 bit 7 marks an AREA ENTRANCE and the low seven bits are the area number; its sprite shows while the area's $04A9 bit is clear, and area 21's only once areas 1-10 are all flagged. CORRECTION: an earlier version said every drawn cell is a sprite, that byte 0 bit 7 means 'drawn', and that byte 1 is a been-there flag. THE CHECK: the 21 records with byte 0 of $82 and byte 2 bit 7 set carry the area numbers 1 to 21, EACH EXACTLY ONCE. Twenty-one areas is what this project established from an unrelated direction - bank 4's per-area table and the CPY #$15 tests - and nothing here was tuned to produce it. All 21 lie in rows 0-23, and the keys they need repeat with period ten across areas 1-10 and 11-20. The extent: walking the whole stream lands on $960F, the first byte of the dialogue pointer table. NOT ESTABLISHED: bits 4-6 of byte 0, everything past byte 2 in the longer records, which run to 16 bytes, and rows 24-33 - 231 records the status screen never draws, holding no entrance.
